assets.style: App icon artwork for a children's English vocabulary tower-defense game, in a soft rounded cartoon style with clean dark-brown outlines, flat colors and gentle shading. Square, full-bleed (the background fills the whole square, no white margin, no rounded-corner mask, no frame). Absolutely no text, letters or numbers.
assets.prompt: a cheerful round sky-blue little monster with dot eyes and a big smile holding up a golden star, in front of a small cream castle with an orange flag, on a soft sky-to-meadow gradient background (light teal sky on top, fresh green grass at the bottom). The monster is big and centered so it reads clearly at small sizes.
